name: What factors affect the cost of skylight installation?
description: Skylight installation costs depend on skylight type, size, roof material, pitch, new vs. replacement, and structural or finishing needs.

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of skylight installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of skylight installation varies based on several factors, including the type and size of the skylight, roof material, roof pitch, and whether it's a new installation or a replacement. Additional costs can arise from structural modifications, interior finishing work, and permits. For example, a large ventilating skylight on a steep tile roof will generally be more expensive than a smaller, fixed skylight on a low-slope asphalt shingle roof. Considering the overall scope of necessary roof and interior work is a key decision factor when budgeting for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Skylight installation costs depend on skylight type, size, roof material, pitch, new vs. replacement, and structural or finishing needs.
